facts.text: The resort sits on a bluff between the Pacific and the Santa Ynez Mountains in Santa Barbara.
facts.excerpt: Perched on a picturesque bluff between the Pacific and the Santa Ynez Mountains is our luxury beach hotel in Santa Barbara.

facts.text: Bacara opened in 2000 as a Mediterranean-style coastal resort on land stewarded by the Chumash people.
facts.excerpt: Originally opened in 2000, Bacara was conceived as a grand Mediterranean-style coastal resort on land stewarded by the Chumash people.

facts.text: A multi-million-dollar renovation of the resort was completed in July 2025.
facts.excerpt: Bacara completed a multi-million-dollar renovation in July 2025 that touched nearly every corner of the resort.

facts.text: The renovation was led by interior design firm Meyer Davis and added local art and Chumash motifs.
facts.excerpt: Led by interior design firm Meyer Davis, the updates introduce more local art and Chumash motifs

facts.text: The architecture is Spanish Colonial Revival, with stucco facades, arched doorways and hand-painted tilework.
facts.excerpt: Built in Spanish Colonial Revival style, common to this stretch of California, the hotel features stucco facades, arched doorways, and hand-painted tilework.

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Suite is a two-bedroom suite of 2,000 sq ft with a separate living space, fireplace and kitchenette.
facts.excerpt: A sprawling two-bedroom suite spanning 2,000 sq ft, with two master bedrooms, a separate living space, fireplace, and kitchenette.

facts.text: The Channel Island Suite is a two-bedroom suite of 3,700 sq ft that suits families or groups of up to eight.
facts.excerpt: Luxuriate in ultimate comfort in our 3,700 sq. ft. two-bedroom suite, perfect for families or groups of up to eight.

facts.text: Lulio serves Mediterranean-inspired fare highlighting local produce and sustainable seafood.
facts.excerpt: Mediterranean-inspired fare highlighting local produce and sustainable seafood at Lulio

facts.text: Marisella is an Italian restaurant serving handmade pastas and wood-grilled seafood.
facts.excerpt: Savor handmade pastas, wood-grilled seafood and expertly crafted martinis in a beautifully appointed Italian restaurant

facts.text: 'O' Bar & Terrace is named for the Chumash word for water and has an open-air loggia with ocean views.
facts.excerpt: Named for the Chumash word for water, ‘O’ features an open-air loggia with ocean views

facts.text: The spa has an adults-only swimming pool, redwood sauna, eucalyptus steam room, cold plunge and a rooftop terrace.
facts.excerpt: including an adults-only swimming pool, redwood sauna, eucalyptus steam room, cold plunge, fireside lounges, a rooftop terrace

facts.text: The resort has four clay tennis courts next to the beach.
facts.excerpt: features four clay tennis courts adjacent to the beach

facts.text: Families can join guided eco-hikes through the Gaviota Coast foothills and birding and butterfly bike-and-hike adventures.
facts.excerpt: join guided eco-hikes through the Gaviota Coast foothills, or take part in birding and butterfly bike-and-hike adventures.

facts.text: Ambassadors of the Environment programs introduce guests to the Gaviota Coast, including kelp forest, birds, the intertidal zone and Chumash culture.
facts.excerpt: including kelp forest, a diversity of birds, the intertidal zone, and traditional Chumash culture

facts.text: The resort is about 12 miles north of downtown Santa Barbara.
facts.excerpt: the Ritz-Carlton Bacara sits about 12 miles north of downtown Santa Barbara

facts.text: Santa Barbara's shops and restaurants are roughly a 20-minute drive away.
facts.excerpt: Santa Barbara’s shops, restaurants, and broader scene are roughly a 20-minute drive away.

facts.text: The property is set on a hill, and an on-demand jitney cart service helps guests move around.
facts.excerpt: While the property is set on a hill, guests with disabilities can make use of the resort’s on-demand jitney cart service to move around the property.

facts.text: The resort welcomes dogs weighing 50 pounds or less in its one- and two-bedroom suites.
facts.excerpt: We are delighted to welcome dogs weighing 50 pounds or less in our one- and two-bedroom Santa Barbara suites.

facts.text: The resort has a resort fee, which comes with a set of included experiences.
